requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF construction_date >= '2017-01-01' AND ship_ice_strengthened = true, THEN independent_echo_sounding_device_count >= 2 OR (echo_sounding_device_count >= 1 AND independent_transducer_count >= 2).
requirement.requiredInputs: Construction date, ice-strengthening status, and echo-sounding equipment topology
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Ships constructed on or after 1 January 2017, ice strengthened in accordance with chapter 3, shall have either two independent echo-sounding devices or one echo-sounding device with two separate independent transducers.
